title.zh: Blockchain malware activity jumps 440% as AI lowers the barrier for North Korea and Iran-linked hackers

current_state.zh: Chainalysis reports blockchain-based malware command-and-control activity surged 440%, with North Korea and Iran-linked hackers accounting for roughly two-thirds of newly observed blockchain dead-drop activity as AI lowers the technical barrier.
